finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache-less load crushed the service.**

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | Cache miss storm, reads go straight to the store |
| 02:14:10 | `TimeoutError: request timed out after 5000ms` starts, 173 total |
| 02:15–02:31 | 13 reconnect attempts, all `ECONNREFUSED` |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes max, `502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`, worker-2 dies code 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back. The log ends at the kill, so no recovery is recorded. One thing to check: the log is dated `2026-07-04`, not last night.

Next: find why Redis at `10.0.0.12` refused connections.
